items.q: Earl and Art Tatum used to hook up, and jam sessions when we'd get off.

ctx.x: Well, there was one at 55th, under the el there, 55th Place, where we used to get together. Earl and Art Tatum used to hook up, and jam sessions when we'd get off.
Were there -- you know, New York, there was an awful lot of what they'd call cutting contests.
